name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 5 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2025-05-12, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.61 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
